data.title: Tierra Viva
data.about:
Tierra Viva by DarGlobal is where you may experience the pinnacle of opulence. This unique DarGlobal initiative is the first branded endeavour in Spain to include the Automobili Lamborghini brand. Enter the luxury of this gated neighbourhood and you’ll find a select group of 53 prestigious villas Tierra Viva’s extraordinary amenities will blow your mind. 

Envision yourself enjoying the convenience of a private lift, the luxury of a swimming pool in which to cool off on hot days, and the serenity of a rooftop terrace from which to take in breathtaking vistas. Indulge in some well-deserved R&R on the chic pool terrace, or watch a movie in the state-of-the-art theatre. Enjoy the refined atmosphere of a wine cellar and the relaxing atmosphere of a steam and sauna area while you’re here. Show and prep kitchens provide high-end, built-in equipment from respected manufacturers like Miele for your convenience. Tierra Viva’s bathrooms are a model of sophistication, with fixtures from such illustrious manufacturers as Duravit and Kohler. Tierra Viva is the pinnacle of luxury living, so don’t pass up the chance to live here. Tierra Viva by DarGlobal is Where Exclusivity Meets Perfection.

location_tile.title: Discover a serene haven set among the fascinating hills outside Los Jaralillos in the coveted Benahavis region.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Tierra Viva by DarGlobal is conveniently located, only minutes from the beautiful beaches of Marbella. Immerse yourself in the surrounding scenery, where 12 golf clubs await your leisurely pastimes. Explore the beauty of Andalusian towns and the elegance of Puerto Banus, all of which are easily accessible from this private property. Tierra Viva provides a tranquil getaway in the centre of a lively neighbourhood, combining calm and energy.

  • 05 Mins from Mediterranean Shores
  • 12 Mins from Puerto Banus
  • 16 Mins from Marbella Club Golden Mile
  • 18 Mins from Nobu Hotel Marbella
  • 40 Mins from Gibraltar
  • 45 Mins from Malaga Costa Del Sol Airport
